name: VanEck Treasury Fund
oneLiner: VBILL is VanEck's tokenized T-bill share advised by Van Eck Absolute Return Advisers and administered via Securitize/State Street.
collateral: Short-duration U.S. Treasury bills and repurchase agreements collateralized by U.S. Treasury obligations, held by a BVI Professional Fund advised by Van Eck Absolute Return Advisers; State Street Bank and Trust Company is custodian, Securitize Fund Services is fund administrator, and Securitize provides tokenization, transfer agency, and KYC
pegMechanism: Institutional T-bill fund token that seeks a stable $1.00 NAV per share; yield accrues daily and is distributed as new tokens issued to holders. Instant mint and redemption at NAV through Securitize Markets against USDC, AUSD, or USD wire. RedStone is the issuer's designated oracle for daily NAV calculation; Pharos reads the on-chain Chainlink NAVLink 'VBILL NAV' feed (adopted by Securitize for the Aave Horizon collateral market) for live NAV

proofOfReserves.provider: Securitize / VanEck (daily AUM, yield, and NAV reporting; public page discloses permitted cash/U.S. Treasury bill/Treasury-repo strategy but not current security-level or category-weighted holdings)

yieldConfig.yieldSource: VanEck Treasury Fund daily token distribution

notices.title: Securitize-administered NAV token
notices.message: VBILL is institutional only via Securitize Markets and issues on Ethereum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, and Solana via Wormhole. Pharos tracks all four deployments.
